mutations.name: a stopped run counts as shipped
kills: mergedInWindow keeps the run merged inside the window, not one merged before it or one stopped inside it

mutations.name: the window end is inclusive
kills: mergedInWindow ends the window at the next day start, exclusive

mutations.name: a changed merged set never marks the digest stale
kills: coord.shipped read marks the digest stale when a PR merged after it was built

mutations.name: the digest file is written world-readable
kills: writeDigest writes the file owner-only and leaves no temp file behind

mutations.name: the read lists every run, not only the finished ones
kills: coord.shipped read reports built:false with the merged list when no digest exists, and calls only Shepherd's finished list
